trajectory_summary: This is a clean, low-friction call: legitimacy established via a named referral, verify items gathered conversationally, bill pain surfaced, husband looped in organically when the customer requested it, and a specific day/time booked with light button-up. The rep held setter scope throughout and never got pulled into product explanation, but left the customer's stated bill pain and interest reason uncapitalized, and the button-up was thin on the required handshake elements.

The husband was already brought onto the call at 02:35 and remained party to the qualifying and booking, so the co-owner is confirmed present for the appointment-setting conversation itself, though not explicitly re-confirmed as attending the actual specialist visit.
